cdse-s3.title: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem S3
cdse-s3.description: This endpoint provides access to EO data which is stored on the object storage of both CloudFerro Cloud and OpenTelekom Cloud (OTC). See the [documentation](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/S3.html) for more information, including how to get credentials.

creodias-s3.title: CREODIAS S3
creodias-s3.description: Comprehensive Earth Observation Data (EODATA) archive offered by CREODIAS as a commercial part of CDSE, designed to provide users with access to a vast repository of satellite data without predefined quota limits.

ew-ocn-vv.title: OCN Measurement Data (VV)

oswPolSpec.description: estimated swell spectrum on log-polar grid

oswPolSpecNV.description: estimated swell spectrum Normalized Variance on log-polar grid

oswQualityCrossSpectraRe.description: real part of cross spectra log-polar grid

oswQualityCrossSpectraIm.description: imaginary part of cross spectra log-polar grid

oswK.description: array of the wavenumbers for polar spectra

oswPhi.description: array of angular values for polar spectra

oswSpecRes.description: azimuth cut-off wavelength as function of wave direction

oswHsNV.description: Significant waveheight for each partition NV mean (new definition)

oswWl.description: Dominant wave length for each partition

oswDirmet.description: Dominant wave direction for each partition (with respect to North)

oswSnr.description: signal to noise ratio of cross spectra

oswAmbiFac.description: ambiguity factor for wave propagation direction

oswIconf.description: confidance flag for wave direction resolution

oswLookSeparationTime.description: Separation time between inner and outer look

oswInten.description: input SLC image intensity estimated within each cell

oswNv.description: Normalised variance of the input SLC image estimated within each cell

oswSkew.description: skewness of the input SLC image estimated within each cell

oswKurt.description: kurtosis of the input SLC image estimated within each cell

oswWindDirection.description: SAR Wind direction (meteorological convention=clockwise direction from where the wind comes respect to North)

oswEcmwfWindDirection.description: ECMWF Wind direction (meteorological convention=clockwise direction from where the wind comes respect to North)

oswWindSeaHs.description: Significant wave height of the wind sea, estimated by extracting the wind sea component from the full wave spectrum without using partitioning.

oswPhs0.description: Significant wave height of the wind sea partition, obtained from the spectral partitioning of the wave spectrum.

oswWaveAge.description: describe the state of dev. of the wind sea component of the wave spectra

oswDepth.description: water depth from GEBCO data set

oswLandFlag.description: land flag : 1 if presence of more than 10% of land coverage, 0 instead

oswLandCoverage.description: percentage of land coverage within the cell

oswGroundRngSize.description: ground range size of the estimation area

oswAziSize.description: azimuth size of the estimation area

oswEllipsLength.description: length of the major axis of the ellipsoid for Group analysis

oswEllipsLengthStdDev.description: standard deviation of the major axis of the ellipsoid for Group analysis

oswEllipsWidth.description: length of the minor axis of the ellipsoid for Group analysis

oswEllipsWidthStdDev.description: standard deviation of the minor axis of the ellipsoid for Group analysis

oswTotalHsStdev.description: Standard deviation of total significant wave height

oswCartSpecIm.description: Imaginary part of half Cartesian cross spectra between the different sub view: zero time lag; 1rst time lag; 2nd time lag

oswCartSpecRe.description: Real part of half Cartesian cross spectra between the different sub view: zero time lag; 1rst time lag; 2nd time lag

oswKx.description: Positive frequencies array of the Cartesian crossSpectra on Range direction

oswKy.description: frequencies array of the Cartesian crossSpectra on Azimuth direction

oswJx.description: Jacobian of the non linear resampling on Range direction of the cartesian CrossSpectra (Half corresponding to positive frequencies)

oswJy.description: Jacobian of the non linear resampling on Azimuth direction of the cartesian CrossSpectra

oswPclut1.description: Estimated clutter noise levels of the cross covariance spectra

oswPclut2.description: Estimated clutter noise levels on cross spectra from which low frequency signal is removed

oswRaSizeSLC.description: Size of SLC swath over Range dimension

oswAzSizeSLC.description: Size of SLC swath over Azimuth dimension

owiWl.description: Dominant wave length for each partition

owiDirmet.description: Dominant wave direction for each partition (with respect to North)

owiWindSeaHs.description: Significant waveheight for the wind sea part of the total wave height

owiSubswathCoverage.description: Percentage of overlap with each subswath

owiIncidenceAngle.description: Incidence angle at wind cell center

owiElevationAngle.description: Elevation Angle at wind cell center

owiWindDirection.description: SAR Wind direction (meteorological convention= clockwise direction from where the wind comes respect to North)

owiEcmwfWindDirection.description: ECMWF Wind direction (meteorological convention= clockwise direction from where the wind comes respect to North)

owiPBright.description: Percentage of bright targets pixels detectied in cell

owiNrcsCmod.description: predicted Normalized Radar Cross Section from CMOD and ECMWF

owiCalConstObsi.description: geophysical calibration constant estimated from ECMWF and CMOD GMF

owiCalConstInci.description: Incidence angles vector corresponding to the geophysical calibration constant estimated from ECMWF and CMOD GMF

owiWindQuality.description: Aggregate wind quality flag taking into account the wind inversion and the data validity

owiNrcsNeszCorr.description: Noise Corrected Nrcs averaged on the owi grid

rvlLandCoverage.description: percentage of land coverage within a cell

rvlLandFlag.description: land flag : 1 if presence of more than 10% of land coverage, 0 instead

rvlDcMiss.description: doppler frequency from antenna mispointing at cell centre

rvlConfDcObs.description: confidence on Estimated doppler centroid frequency

rvlUssX.description: Longitudinal component of surface stokes drift from Wavewatch III model

rvlUssY.description: Meridional component of surface stokes drift from Wavewatch III model

rvlPitch.description: satellite pitch at zero Doppler time

rvlYaw.description: satellite yaw at zero Doppler time

rvlRoll.description: satellite roll at zero Doppler time

rvlSlantRangeTime.description: two way slant range time to cell center

rvlZeroDopplerTime.description: zero doppler time at cell center

rvlGroundRngSize.description: Ground range size of estimation area
